scope_rationale: Finite84 lock-free-stack-treiber requires actual head/link push/pop, beyond retained queue/deque/tagged pool.

competencies.outcome: Implement actual single-head Treiber push/pop with protected revalidation, immutable published links and precise LIFO linearization.
Bind reclamation to the exact retired generation and diagnose a collector delayed across reuse and a new protected incarnation.
Implement finite pool refusal, stalled-reader cancellation and generation exhaustion without reclaiming a live borrow; distinguish progress classes.
Falsify publication and validation omissions using the actual C implementation, independent real-time stack histories and precise target/resource limits.
